step_by_step_reasoning: The visual diagram displays a backend architecture for a fantasy sports platform. Mobile and Web users interact via API Gateway, which invokes Lambda functions communicating with MongoDB. CloudWatch triggers Lambda to move match data from MongoDB to S3. External Game APIs send live score updates via Lambda to S3. Data in S3 is processed using EMR for leaderboard calculations and fed into Redshift for analytics. Services are mapped strictly to the AWS schema names.
